results.rationale: The controller retains its blue casing, controls and angle, but the small central logo is distorted. The gray-blue background, elevated placement and soft shadow follow the poster brief; the huge duplicated “start Start!” text omits “Press” and the requested punctuation, compromising the restrained layout. The poster is otherwise coherent, with the malformed controller logo a small quality flaw.

Marble chips have been placed inside the original tube, while its position, outline and label remain matched apart from slight label-edge texture changes. The added chips fulfill the main action, but no reaction is visible: the liquid lacks the bubbles explicitly expected from marble and hydrochloric acid. The stones, glass and lighting are visually coherent and artifact-free.
